notes: PROPOSAL only, NOT enqueued (worker does NOT create/mutate tasks via taskctl). B109 froze the OUTPUT contract of the 11 read-only geoai-task-mcp tools, complementing B108 (input-schema freeze). Over a REAL MCP ClientSession (initialize/tools_list/tools_call) with core.run_taskctl replaced by an in-process stub and a subprocess tripwire (launch_attempts=0), it snapshots a value->type SKELETON of every read-only tool's structuredContent result and byte-freezes its sha256; all leaf values (absolute/tmp paths, pids, timestamps, argv/command strings, env-dependent bools, ordering) are normalized to type tokens so the freeze is deterministic across runs AND across two independent client sessions. No queue/audit write with GEOAI_TASK_MCP_ALLOW_WRITES unset AND =1 (byte-identical empty audit state dir). frozen_output_contract_v1=true, but authority_flags (contract_frozen/process_launch_authority/write_gate_enabled/runtime_authority/default_authority) remain FALSE at worker scope: Codex review finalizes any authority. No process launch is enabled and none is proposed until the FINAL gated executor, behind ALL launch_preconditions plus ALLOW_LAUNCH=1 AND ALLOW_WRITES=1. Adapter/runner/topic SELECTION must become a learned router (MCP_NEURAL_LAUNCH_ROUTING_MIGRATION_V1), never a regex/keyword cue router.
